headline: Software Engineer | AI/LLM Integration | Full-Stack Development
summary: 2nd-year CS sophomore at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (Delhi NCR) with CGPA 9.2. Hands-on experience building AI-integrated products and backend services. Former intern at Buzz to Brand (FastAPI, Gemini API, AWS) and Social House Learning (PRDs, Next.js). Passionate about LLM integration, semantic search, and product-oriented engineering.

projects.name: SkinSoul - AI Skin Analysis App
projects.description: Mobile-first app that analyses skin conditions from selfies and generates personalised skincare routines. Gemini Vision model classifies condition type and severity; a prompt-chained LLM step produces a morning/evening routine.
metrics: 88% classification accuracy on held-out test set of 500 images
60% reduction in cold-start latency via Redis caching
highlights: Gemini Vision API for multi-class skin condition classification
Prompt chaining: classification -> severity grading -> routine generation
Redis caching keyed on skin type hash
pgvector similarity search for product reviews

projects.name: AI Recruiter - Personal AI Job Search Assistant
projects.description: Full-stack AI recruiter application to maximise callback and interview rates. Semantically matches resumes to job listings, generates tailored cover letters, tracks application pipeline.
metrics: 3x higher callback rate in manual testing vs generic applications
<100ms API P95 latency for all sync endpoints
highlights: Clean 4-layer architecture: endpoint -> service -> repository -> DB
pgvector cosine similarity for resume-to-job semantic matching
Generic BaseRepository[T] eliminates CRUD duplication across 5 domain models
Celery + Redis for async embedding generation

projects.name: DevCollab - Real-time Collaborative Code Editor
projects.description: Browser-based code editor supporting real-time collaboration with conflict-free editing, syntax highlighting, and live cursor tracking.
highlights: Operational Transformation (OT) algorithm for conflict-free concurrent edits
Socket.io rooms with Redis pub/sub for cross-instance broadcasting
JWT with refresh-token rotation (15 min access / 7 day refresh)
Role-based access control at both API and socket layer

projects.name: Campus Pulse - Student Event Discovery Platform
projects.description: Internal platform for SRM Delhi NCR students to discover, register for, and track campus events. Replaced a fragmented WhatsApp-group announcement system.
metrics: Replaced manual announcements for 12 student clubs
highlights: Cloudinary for event poster uploads with automatic WebP conversion
